papers.title: Systematic Review of Place-Based Hot Spots Policing and Crime Prevention
papers.authors: Sherman, L. W., Weisburd, D., & Gill, C.
papers.key_finding: Focused hot-spot resource allocation achieves statistically significant crime reductions without spatial displacement.
papers.evidence_summary: Meta-analysis of 62 evaluations demonstrates that focused hot-spot resource allocation achieves statistically significant crime reductions without spatial displacement.
papers.applicability: Applicable for high or increasing crime regimes.

papers.title: Environmental Design Interventions for Urban Property Crime Mitigation
papers.authors: Welsh, B. C., & Farrington, D. P.
papers.key_finding: Improved street lighting and natural surveillance reduce property crime by 14% to 21%.
papers.evidence_summary: Systematic review confirms that improved street lighting and natural surveillance reduce property crime by 14% to 21%.
papers.applicability: Applicable for property crime reduction in urban districts.

papers.title: Markov Switching Models in Spatio-Temporal Crime Analysis
papers.authors: Gupta, R., & Kumar, S.
papers.key_finding: Regime-aware Markov switching models improve multi-horizon forecast accuracy compared to regime-agnostic baselines.
papers.evidence_summary: Demonstrates that regime-aware Markov switching models improve multi-horizon forecast accuracy compared to regime-agnostic baselines.
papers.applicability: Methodological reference for ANVESHA CRIME-SHIFT engine.
